what: Original images made for this app. They are not copies of a published photograph and carry no third-party licence.
animalsVehiclesThings: Photorealistic pictures, saved as 512×512 WebP quality 70.
dinosaurs: Photorealistic paleoart reconstructions of living animals. They are not photographs of real dinosaurs, not fossils, and not cartoons. Colours are plausible earth tones, not a claim that the species was known to be that exact colour. Pteranodon is a flying reptile; its picture is used only after it is dug up, and it is not listed in the dinosaur picture book.
blackPanther: The black-panther picture is a slender melanistic leopard, with the rosettes still visible. The spoken facts match that: it is a leopard with black fur, and a jaguar can be black too.
files: animals/*.webp, vehicles/*.webp, things/*.webp and dinos/*.webp added in this change. Older pictures in those folders were already in the app.
